title: S5 - Validation and live deployment
description: Weeks 9-10. Exit: accuracy, usability, security and device-performance gates pass; production configuration, restore drill, signed build and handover are complete. Store approval timing remains external.
goal: Validate and release the pilot within ten weeks.
entry_criteria: Confirm owners and realistic capacity before starting.
Required predecessor deliverables are available or scheduled in dependency order.

exit_criteria.description: All sprint issues meet their acceptance criteria and completion evidence requirements.
Present signed-off accuracy, usability and security evidence, a working production build and operational handover.

demo: Present signed-off accuracy, usability and security evidence, a working production build and operational handover.
risks: Reserve time for defects; no new features.
Store approval is external and must be reported separately from submission.

execution_plan.first_week: Work prerequisites first; review integration and measurement risks midweek.
execution_plan.second_week: Integrate, execute acceptance checks, fix defects and demonstrate the sprint outcome.
execution_plan.capacity_policy: Estimates are provisional; reserve approximately 20% of actual team capacity for integration and defects.

acceptance_criteria.description: Report per-exercise angle errors, repeatability, repetition errors and tracking failures using the predetermined sample and reference method.
Document camera geometry, lighting, affected side, device and algorithm versions for reproducibility.
Therapist reviews results and supported-use limitations; failed exercises are fixed and retested or excluded explicitly.
Published results distinguish pose estimates from validated reference measurements.

Validate consent withdrawal, access revocation and retention workflows; document remaining limitations.

acceptance_criteria.description: Report feedback latency, FPS, thermal/battery behavior and stability across the declared device matrix.
Measure ordinary online app response against the approximately three-second PDF target under recorded network conditions.
Repeat representative patient tasks in both languages and record completion and error rates.
Fix failing release gates and rerun the affected evaluation before sign-off.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every validation failure has a linked defect, owner and disposition.
No open critical security, measurement-validity or completed-session data-loss defect remains.
Affected tests are rerun after fixes; final evidence names the exact candidate build.
Record go/no-go before deployment and handover; scope reductions require explicit therapist/project-owner agreement.
